title: Turkish-Style Bulgur Salad (Kisir)
description: A classic Turkish salad made with bulgur, onions, tomatoes, and spices. Perfect for a light and refreshing meal or as a side dish.
instructions: Rinse the bulgur in a fine mesh sieve and drain well.
In a large bowl, combine the bulgur, chopped onion, diced tomato, and diced yellow pepper.
Add the chopped parsley, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix well.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the salad chilled or at room temperature.
